name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue is that the password reset email is generating a link starting with "http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=..." due to the BASE_URL being set to process.env.PUBLIC_URL or falling back to "http://localhost:3000" if the environment variable is not set. This causes the reset password link to point to localhost instead of the actual production URL, which is likely why the link doesn't load for external users. The code to fix would involve ensuring the BASE_URL environment variable is properly set to the deployed site's URL during the build or deploy process.

input.title: Fix password reset email link to use correct base URL
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email link currently uses a hardcoded fallback base URL of http://localhost:3000 if the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. This causes reset links in emails to point to localhost when run in deployment without PUBLIC_URL configured. Update the documentation or code to ensure that the correct public URL environment variable is set in deployed environments so the reset link is valid for end users.
